purpose: Teach: かっこう/細長い/薄暗い/スグ/熟睡/退散/公私/この上ない

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、かっこうの良いコートでお越しになったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer had such a striking coat on.
lines.style: Warm observation, almost to herself. Soft smile in the voice. A gentle compliment that lands without trying too hard.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、細長いカップで提供するメニューも増やしたいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I've been thinking we should add more drinks in those tall, slim cups.
lines.style: Thoughtful proposal, leaning forward slightly in tone. Open to input. Not directive — collaborative, testing the idea aloud.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、薄暗い照明にすると落ち着いた雰囲気になるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The lighting when we dim it like this — it really does create a calm feeling, doesn't it?
lines.style: Reflective, almost meditative. Noticing something true that's been there all along. Quiet pause before the question. Speaking as if Mei just joined her in seeing it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、注文はスグにご提供できるよう頑張ろうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We should keep working on getting orders out as quickly as we can.
lines.style: Steady, grounded. Not pushing — a gentle commitment. The voice of someone who takes the small promises seriously.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、休憩で熟睡しちゃったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I actually fell asleep during my break, can you believe that?
lines.style: Self-deprecating laugh just underneath. A small confession, almost to herself. Shaking her head a little. Inviting Mei in on the joke about her own exhaustion.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、混雑時はクレーマーがスグ退散するくらい毅然と対応しようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: When it gets really busy, we need to stay firm enough that complainers just don't stick around.
lines.style: Clear-eyed and steady. Not cold — professional. The voice of someone who's learned the hard way what boundaries look like. Direct without harshness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、店長として公私を分けるのが大事ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I think it matters to keep work and personal life separate, especially as the manager.
lines.style: Quiet realization, like she's understanding it as she says it. No certainty — just careful thought. Speaking partly to Mei, partly thinking aloud about the weight of the role.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の笑顔はこの上ない宝物ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The smile on a customer's face — there's no greater treasure than that.
lines.style: Tender, almost vulnerable. A rare full glimpse of what drives her. Said slowly, with the kind of sincerity she usually keeps close. Trailing warmly into the silence.
